name: Juressa Lee
current_positions: 绿色和平大洋洲组织(Greenpeace Aotearoa) 海床采矿运动负责人

work_experience.description: Campaigning to stop seabed mining in Aotearoa, including the Taranaki seabed mining application by Trans-Tasman Resources. Led successful campaign resulting in TTR withdrawing its Fast Track application in February 2026.

Worked on plastics pollution campaigns and represented Greenpeace at the Intergovernmental Negotiating Committee for the Global Plastics Treaty in Paris (May-June 2023). Also served as delegate to the Aotearoa Plastic Pollution Alliance.

work_experience.organization: International Indigenous Peoples' Forum on Plastics (IIPFP)
work_experience.description: Co-chaired the International Indigenous Peoples' Forum on Plastics, advocating for indigenous rights in global plastics treaty negotiations, including at INC-5 in Busan (November 2024).

biography_summary: 朱瑞莎·李（Juressa Lee）是新西兰环保组织绿色和平大洋洲（Greenpeace Aotearoa）的海床采矿运动负责人，具有泰拉拉瓦（Te Rarawa）、纳普伊（Ngāpuhi）和拉罗汤加（Rarotonga）的毛利和太平洋岛民血统。她长期致力于阻止新西兰及太平洋地区的海床采矿活动，保护海洋生物和深海生态系统，推动从破坏性采矿主义向循环经济转型。她曾担任绿色和平塑料污染运动负责人，代表组织参与2023年巴黎全球塑料条约谈判。她还担任国际原住民塑料论坛（IIPFP）共同主席，在联合国环境大会等国际论坛上为原住民权利发声。她成功领导了反对澳大利亚跨塔斯曼资源公司（Trans-Tasman Resources）在塔拉纳基海床采矿申请的运动，最终迫使对方于2026年2月撤回申请。2026年5月，她向国会递交了超过26000人签名的请愿书，呼吁总理卢克森拒绝与美国的矿产协议。她也是库克群岛海床采矿延迟决定的重要推动者之一。

collection_meta.notes: No birth date or education information available publicly. Tribal affiliations (Te Rarawa, Ngapuhi, Rarotonga) confirmed from multiple sources. Active campaigner with strong media presence.
